text: The Bangladesh Sustainable Recovery, Emergency Preparedness and Response Project (B-STRONG) is a World Bank-financed initiative aimed at reducing flood risk and enhancing recovery efforts in Bangladesh, particularly in the Sylhet and Chattogram Divisions. The project focuses on rebuilding critical infrastructure, strengthening flood protection systems, and supporting climate-resilient agriculture and livelihoods. It integrates physical infrastructure improvements with community preparedness and economic inclusion measures to build systemic resilience against natural disasters.
